column1: # bada ime: English -> Korean dictionary of common English words (layout 15, bada hybrid).
# Typing a lowercase English word offers the Korean word(s), then the English word written in Hangul.
# Built from engine/data/en-words.txt (filtered, lemmatized, frequency order), then common words it
# lacks (verbs/adjectives/abstract nouns, then concrete nouns), translated by hand (Claude, 2026-11).
# Function words, pronouns, auxiliaries, number words and proper nouns are left out. US spelling.
# Vulgar, slur, sexual and drug words live in sensitive.tsv (built only with make SENSITIVE=1).
# Nouns only, with one exception. A row is either:
#   - a noun (pos = noun): korean holds noun glosses only (red -> 빨강, not 빨간/빨갛다);
#   - a non-noun Koreans borrow as it is (pos = verb/adj/adv; smart 스마트, cool 쿨, agile 에자일):
#     korean is EMPTY and only the Hangul spelling is offered, never nominalized (no -하다).
#   Other verbs, adjectives and adverbs are set aside in non-nouns.tsv (not built).
#   english  lowercase base form (headword), most common first
#   korean   noun glosses, most common sense first, ", "-separated, at most 4 (empty for non-nouns)
#   hangul   the English word in Hangul: the established spelling Koreans actually use first
#            (colloquial beats 외래어 표기법: foil 호일, shop 샵, python 파이썬; app 앱, family 패밀리);
#            otherwise written as it sounds, with English short a /æ/ as ㅔ (agile 에자일)
